message: Using latest is prone to errors if the image will ever update. Pin the version explicitly to a release tag
Pin versions in apt get install. Instead of `apt-get install <package>` use `apt-get install <package>=<version>`
Delete the apt lists (/var/lib/apt/lists) after installing something
Use WORKDIR to switch to a directory
Double quote to prevent globbing and word splitting.
Use $(...) notation instead of legacy backticks `...`.

unexpected 'N'
expecting '#', '\', ADD, ARG, CMD, COPY, ENTRYPOINT, ENV, EXPOSE, FROM, HEALTHCHECK, LABEL, MAINTAINER, ONBUILD, RUN, SHELL, STOPSIGNAL, USER, VOLUME, WORKDIR, a pragma, at least one space, or end of input
Pin versions in pip. Instead of `pip install <package>` use `pip install <package>==<version>` or `pip install --requirement <requirements file>`
Avoid use of cache directory with pip. Use `pip install --no-cache-dir <package>`
Last USER should not be root
Non-numeric user-id may not be resolvable by host system
